question: Does WeIntern provide placement support?
answer: Yes. The 6-Month Internship Program (₹6,599) includes 100% placement guarantee with resume review, mock interview preparation, LinkedIn profile building, and job assistance. The 3-Month Program (₹999) includes placement support but does not carry a 100% guarantee.

question: Is placement 100% guaranteed?
answer: 100% placement guarantee is included in the 6-Month Internship Program (₹6,599). The 3-Month Program (₹999) provides placement support but does not include a 100% placement guarantee.

question: What is included in the placement support?
answer: The 6-Month Program includes: Mock Interview preparation, Professional LinkedIn profile building, Resume review and improvement, 100% placement guarantee, and Job assistance. The 3-Month Program includes: Placement support (without 100% guarantee).

question: What is the placement process?
answer: The placement process includes: 1) Resume review and professional strengthening. 2) Mock interview preparation. 3) LinkedIn profile building for recruiter visibility. 4) Job assistance and application guidance. Students in the 6-Month Program receive 100% placement guarantee.

question: Will I get resume review?
answer: Yes. The 6-Month Internship Program (₹6,599) includes professional resume review and improvement as part of the placement support package.

question: Will I get mock interviews?
answer: Yes. Mock Interview preparation is a dedicated feature of the 6-Month Internship Program (₹6,599). It helps you practice and improve your performance in real hiring conversations.

question: Will I get LinkedIn profile building?
answer: Yes. Professional LinkedIn profile building is included in the 6-Month Internship Program (₹6,599) to help you get noticed by recruiters.

question: Will I get job assistance?
answer: Yes. Job assistance is included in the 6-Month Program (₹6,599) as part of the placement support, which carries a 100% placement guarantee. The 3-Month Program also provides placement support.

question: Is placement guarantee available in the 3-month program?
answer: The 3-Month Program (₹999) does not include a 100% placement guarantee, but it does provide placement support. If you want 100% placement guarantee, the 6-Month Program (₹6,599) is the right choice.

question: Which program gives placement guarantee?
answer: The 6-Month Internship Program (₹6,599) comes with 100% placement guarantee. It also includes mock interview preparation, resume review, and LinkedIn profile building. The 3-Month Program (₹999) provides placement support without the 100% guarantee.

question: Can I improve my placement chances?
answer: Yes. Complete your live projects, prepare for mock interviews, strengthen your resume, and build your LinkedIn profile. The 6-Month Program (₹6,599) provides dedicated placement support and 100% placement guarantee to maximize your chances.
